hypotheses.persona: A single working adult who commutes to work on weekdays, returns in the evening for a meal, and engages in evening DIY/hobby projects. On weekends, they stay home, relax, and have later meals.
hypotheses.rationale: Consistent weekday morning departure (keys, phone at 08:19) and evening return (keys at entry_hook at 17:25). Bowl at sink at 07:34 suggests breakfast before work. Weekend pattern shows no morning departure, afternoon nap, and later meals. Evening DIY/hobby (paint_roller, radio) on weekdays and weekends.

hypotheses.persona: A person who works from home or has a flexible schedule, with occasional evening DIY projects.
hypotheses.rationale: The strong weekday departure pattern makes this less likely, but retained in case future evidence (e.g., a weekday where keys stay home) emerges.
